title: Adjacency in an encoded graph
statement: Let $v$ be a natural number, let $G$ encode a graph on the vertex set $\{0,\ldots,v-1\}$ by assigning a Boolean value to each two-element vertex set, and let $u,w$ be vertices. Then $u$ and $w$ are adjacent in $G$ precisely when they are distinct and some two-element set assigned value true contains both of them.
